novelty_flags.label: thm:closed-form-harm-interval gap and seed:joint-stayer-harm-box rebuttal
novelty_flags.one_line: They say KroftMourifieVayalinkal2024 leaves aggregate mean bounds as a response-type optimization, but its Theorem 1(iii) explicitly presents sharp closed-form bounds for a weighted aggregate LCDE.

novelty_flags.label: oeq:joint-numerical-delta-validity
novelty_flags.one_line: At fixed finite L, the asserted pointwise numerical-delta conclusion is covered by HongLi2018 after the core's own ambient Hadamard-directional lemma and multinomial bootstrap premise; simultaneous ties and zero cells do not by themselves create a new pointwise regime.

soundness_flags.label: prop:confidence-set-image-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposition expressly reduces to the definition of J and the implication that a covered point belongs to the set over which its endpoints are optimized; it has no substantive step and should be a supporting implementation note, not a to-prove result.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:positive-stayer-floor and all sharp-ID claims
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The observable condition sum_d ell_d >= kappa is maintained, rather than derived from the ordered-selection model.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The prism and interval are sharp conditional on P belonging to D_{L,kappa}; this condition guarantees a positive actual stayer denominator and does not assume the prism or its endpoints.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1(iii) presents sharp closed-form bounds for a weighted average of LCDEs; the paper separately notes that inference for that aggregate can involve higher-dimensional optimization.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 11-12, Proposition 2 and definitions of A(x), B(x), and C(x)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Under random assignment, positive mass, and monotone sample selection, Proposition 2 gives sharp conditional probability-of-causation bounds for the always-observed subgroup.
Theorem 2 gives the sharp interval for the fraction negatively affected from observed arm outcome functions via conditional Fréchet-Hoeffding completion.
The paper establishes conditional bounded-Lipschitz consistency for a resampling estimate of a directional derivative under its stated directional-differentiability and bootstrap conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 3, pointwise numerical directional-delta validity
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For suitably shrinking step sizes, the numerical derivative method supplies consistent pointwise inference for Hadamard directionally differentiable functions; uniform validity requires additional convex-Lipschitz structure.
Calibrated projection builds confidence intervals for projections of partially identified parameters and establishes uniform asymptotic coverage over a broad DGP class.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the Kroft--Mourifie--Vayalinkal comparison: acknowledge its closed-form aggregate mean bounds, then state precisely that the new object is a cross-world binary-harm prism and an unidentified-denominator ratio contraction.
Remove the confidence-set image implication from the research-result list and retain it as an implementation fallback; it should not consume a theorem/proposition slot.

Either demote the pointwise numerical-delta question to a direct application of Hong--Li or replace it with a genuinely unaddressed uniform local-sequence result across hinge and structural-zero faces, with an explicit failure/coverage target.

Add a strict observable comparison showing what the prism delivers that the multilayer mean-effect framework cannot, preferably over a nondegenerate open family and with the comparator's closed-form aggregate target stated accurately.
